items.name: Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
items.desc: Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.

items.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.desc: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

items.name: Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
items.desc: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

items.name: Mitel MiCollab XML Injection Vulnerability
items.desc: Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

items.name: Mitel MiCollab OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.desc: Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.

items.name: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.desc: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

items.name: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.desc: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

items.name: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.desc: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. items.name: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.desc: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

items.name: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
items.desc: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

items.name: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
items.desc: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

items.name: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
items.desc: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.name: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.desc: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

items.name: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
items.desc: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

items.name: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
items.desc: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

items.name: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.desc: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information, including internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names.

items.name: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
items.desc: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

items.name: Mitel MiCollab Weak Authentication Vulnerability
items.desc: Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content.

items.name: Mitel MiCollab Not Failing Securely Vulnerability
items.desc: Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

items.name: Mitel MiCollab Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
items.desc: Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component due to insufficient file type validation that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.
